# RSIC 2026

> RSIC is a student-run inter-school competition in Pakistan, presented by The City School, Ravi Campus. It runs from Friday 13 to Sunday 15 November 2026 at TCS Ravi, with eleven competitions called Realms.

Schools register as a delegation of 5 to 7 delegates. A delegation enters 4 to 6 realms: one core realm (Project Nexus or Gaia's Exchange) and 3 to 5 more. Entry is open to O Levels (Grade 9) and above. Registrations are open now.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cityrsic.com/): countdown, the eleven realms and how to enter
- [About](https://cityrsic.com/about): why RSIC exists and the disciplines it covers
- [Realms](https://cityrsic.com/realms): all eleven realms, with format and team size
- [Register](https://cityrsic.com/register): the delegation form, downloadable forms and common questions
- [Experience](https://cityrsic.com/experience): what taking part is like
- [Team](https://cityrsic.com/team): the Founders Council and the Executive Council's letter
- [Code of Conduct](https://cityrsic.com/conduct): the Charter of Discipline
- [Updates](https://cityrsic.com/updates): what has been released and what is coming
- [Media](https://cityrsic.com/media): campaign art

## Realms

- [Project Nexus](https://cityrsic.com/realms/nexus): Pure Sciences, core realm
- [Gaia's Exchange](https://cityrsic.com/realms/gaias-exchange): Environmental Business, core realm
- [The Cartesian Realm](https://cityrsic.com/realms/cartesian): Mathematics
- [The Watson Street](https://cityrsic.com/realms/watson-street): Biology
- [Curie's Chamber](https://cityrsic.com/realms/curies-chamber): Chemistry
- [Astral Axiom](https://cityrsic.com/realms/astral-axiom): Physics
- [Hypatia's Enclave](https://cityrsic.com/realms/hypatias-enclave): Computer Science
- [Pterion's Sanctum](https://cityrsic.com/realms/pterions-sanctum): Psychology
- [The Joker's Act](https://cityrsic.com/realms/jokers-act): Film & Drama
- [Athena's Bench](https://cityrsic.com/realms/athenas-bench): Law & Sociology
- [Theseus' Circuit](https://cityrsic.com/realms/theseus-circuit): Robotics
